categories.main_business_segments: Daesung Energy Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the city gas supply sector, providing natural gas for residential, commercial, industrial, and transportation uses. It also operates compressed natural gas (CNG) fueling stations for city buses and a combined heat and power plant supplying heat and electricity in Daegu. Subsidiaries focus on gas facility management, safety, and installation services, supporting the core gas supply business.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company relies on imported liquefied natural gas (LNG) from multiple countries, which is stored and vaporized at domestic receiving terminals before distribution via extensive pipeline networks. It employs advanced pipeline management software and gas safety technologies, including patented systems for fuel cells, gas leak detection, and remote metering. The company also invests in renewable energy technologies such as solar and wind hybrid power systems and fuel cell development.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Daesung Energy serves residential households, commercial businesses, industrial users, and public transportation fleets within its supply regions. The major market is the Daegu metropolitan area and adjacent regions, with over 1.22 million households supplied. The company also caters to municipal and industrial customers requiring heat and electricity through its combined energy systems.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Daegu city and surrounding areas in Gyeongsangbuk-do province, including Gyeongsan, Chilgok, and Goryeong counties. Its infrastructure includes pipelines and facilities concentrated in this region, with no significant operations outside these areas.
categories.supply_chain_position: Daesung Energy functions mainly as a downstream utility company, purchasing natural gas wholesale from Korea Gas Corporation and distributing it directly to end-users via its pipeline network. It also operates midstream facilities such as gas receiving terminals and CNG fueling stations, but does not engage in upstream gas production or import activities.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes safety management and customer service excellence in its operations. R&D efforts focus on energy efficiency, renewable energy integration, and smart gas metering technologies. It has expanded into hydrogen fuel supply and related infrastructure as part of diversification, while maintaining core city gas supply stability. Future plans include sustaining hydrogen fueling operations and exploring new business areas cautiously.
categories.revenue_model: Daesung Energy generates revenue primarily through the sale of city gas to residential, commercial, industrial, and transportation customers. Additional income streams include fees from heat and electricity supply via its combined energy business and service fees from subsidiaries managing gas facilities and safety. Pricing is regulated, with wholesale gas costs linked to government-set rates and retail prices adjusted accordingly.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Within its supply region, Daesung Energy holds a monopoly position with no direct competitors. Nationally, it is one of the major city gas suppliers, accounting for approximately 4.5% of Korea's total gas supply volume, competing with larger firms like Samchully, Kyungdong, Seoul Gas, and Coway ES. The company is positioned as a stable regional utility with a focus on safety and service quality.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, Daesung Energy has total assets of approximately 803 billion KRW and a capital base of 27.5 billion KRW. Its annual revenue is near 1 trillion KRW, with over 97% derived from city gas sales. The company has shown stable profitability with operating income of about 20 billion KRW and net income of nearly 15 billion KRW in 2023, reflecting growth in operating efficiency despite slight sales volume declines.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Daesung Energy offers reliable and safe city gas supply backed by government-regulated pricing, ensuring stable revenue and customer trust. Its extensive pipeline infrastructure and integrated service subsidiaries provide comprehensive gas management and safety services, aiming for zero safety incidents. The company differentiates itself through customer-centric management, advanced technology adoption, and diversification into hydrogen fuel and combined energy solutions.
